title: Try Speedometer Live Wallpaper online: GPS speed and HUD demo
description: Try the Speedometer live wallpaper in your browser: every car dashboard style and the HUD mode heads-up display, with your real GPS speed. Get it on Google Play.

social.title: Try Speedometer Live Wallpaper online
social.description: The real live wallpaper, running in your browser: every car dashboard style and its HUD mode, with your real speed, battery and clock.
social.imageAlt: Speedometer Live Wallpaper: a phone on a car's dashboard at night, showing the Amber Night gauges at 87 km/h, with rain and city lights on the windscreen

@graph.name: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, online demo
@graph.description: The Speedometer live wallpaper running in the browser: every car dashboard style, its layouts and settings, and HUD mode, the heads-up display that puts your speed on the windscreen, with the browser's real clock, battery and GPS speed where it has them, and a demo drive for the rest.
@graph.operatingSystem: Any, in a browser with WebAssembly
@graph.browserRequirements: Requires WebAssembly with garbage collection: Chrome or Edge 119, Firefox 120, Safari 18.2 or later

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play and it opens on this style the first time.
labels.unlock: Each premium style is €2.39, once, with VAT in most of the euro area (Google Play shows yours). Or get every style and no ads with Speedometer Plus, €0.99 a month or €9.99 a year, the first 7 days free for new subscribers.

hud.label: HUD mode
hud.note: Lay your phone flat on the dashboard, screen up, and read your speed on the windscreen. The styles marked HUD draw it (Horizon, Glass, Pulse and Vector): with one of them on show, pick one of its HUD layouts under Layouts, or switch Original | HUD, to see its HUD look right here, and back. Use my real speed first for your GPS speed.
hud.brightness: Turn your screen’s brightness all the way up. Works best at dusk, at night and on cloudy days. Tap for Exit and Flip.

invite.title: HUD mode, ready to start
invite.text: Lay your phone flat on the dashboard in front of the wheel, screen up, turn its brightness all the way up and read your speed on the windscreen. Set it up while parked.

end.title: Want it in your car?
end.text: HUD mode is free in the app, with Horizon’s four HUD looks, and it can open by itself when your phone joins your car’s Bluetooth.
